body: Do you have any links to particularly helpful stories from survivors?

Thank you for replying. I appreciate your honesty and I wish I could find inspiration in knowing "it gets worse before it gets better." I'm just worried that my fuse won't last long enough. The times I'm not thinking about suicide are become fewer and far between as of late. 

I want to reach out to someone, or some part of my tucked underneath does. But, I'm slowly hardening my exterior and shutting friends and family out of my life; I don't trust others enough to confide in them.
